verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own site directly claims that its agents get past forms, CAPTCHAs and login prompts automatically, including logging in through login walls, which covers every element of the story. The support is homepage marketing only, with no technical docs or hands-on corroboration. The pauseWhen feature hands control back to a human, so it is not credited as automatic. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the CAPTCHA-solving and authentication mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration that walls are bypassed without intervention.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
